info.title: Discover229 API
info.description: API Documentation for Discover229 Backend with Laravel Sanctum SPA Authentication

post.summary: Login user and set authentication cookie
post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Token is set in HTTP-only cookie automatically.

get.summary: Get CSRF token and initialize session
get.description: This endpoint initializes the session and sets the CSRF token in an HTTP-only cookie. Must be called before making POST requests with statefulApi. For SPAs using the same domain, cookies are handled automatically by the browser.

204.description: Session initialized successfully. CSRF token set in HTTP-only cookie.

get.description: Redirects the user to the OAuth provider login page.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The OAuth provider (google, facebook, or github)

get.description: Handles the OAuth provider callback and authenticates the user with HTTP-only cookie.

302.description: Redirects to frontend with authenticated session

post.description: Creates a new user account and logs them in with HTTP-only cookie authentication.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile information.

get.summary: Get all modules with their permissions

post.summary: Assign a role to a user

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user

get.summary: Get users with a specific role

sanctum.description: Enter your Sanctum token in the format: your-token-here
